items.information:
## Welcome to the IUKL Final Solve 2025!

[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/IUKLFinalSolve2025)

All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IUKLFinalSolve2025#57619-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IUKLFinalSolve2025#57620-new-competitors) for essential details before registering.
​
Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
​
***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.name: SCU I: May the Fourth Be With You 2025

venue.name: Santa Clara University
venue.address: 500 El Camino Real Santa Clara, CA 95053
venue.details: Sobrato Campus for Discovery and Innovation (SCDI Building, 3rd Floor, Rooms 3115 & 3116)

items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

- Current SCU students may register for free by sending Professor Marks (rmarks@scu.edu) an email from their @scu.edu account prior to registering with this site.
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups.
- Please inspect the schedule for this competition carefully before registering. In particular, note that there is a 4-5 hour gap between the first rounds and final rounds so that we can hold the multi-location Fewest Moves Challenge (FMC) Western Championship. Better yet, if you would like to participate in FMC, it will be held in the same location and can be registered for [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2025).

items.name: American Dream NJ 2025

venue.name: American Dream
venue.address: 1 American Dream Way, East Rutherford, NJ 07073

items.information:
This event is located at the 2nd floor above the Ice Skating Rink. The entrance is near Toys"R"Us.
https://www.americandream.com/map

This competition is a fundraiser to the Myocarditis Foundation, which is led by world-renowned physicians, researchers and patients who volunteer their time. It funds research fellowship projects and partners with researchers in order to improve diagnosis and find new therapies. All proceeds from this competition will go to the Myocarditis Foundation. Please see the Sponsor/Fundraiser tab for more details.

items.name: WCC Western FMC Championship 2025
items.information:
- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. **We do not recommend new competitors attend this competition.**

- This competition will take place at different venues across California, Nevada, and Hawaii.  Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2024#52263-locations) for more details.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
​
